elements.description:
Any chart from a JSON spec – checked first, then drawn with the chart the spec names; what's wrong is shown instead
of a chart, and reported.

properties.name: spec
properties.description: The chart as JSON: { type, data, encoding?, options?, title?, description? }

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-spec-check
events.description: The spec was checked ({ valid, errors, warnings }: ChartSpecCheck)

props.name: onSpecCheck
props.description: The spec was checked: valid, with its errors and warnings

changelog: **`tc-chart`, the CLI and MCP tools:** 39 chart types (`rose`, `hexbin`, `network`); `suggestCharts` proposes a hexbin for thousands of points, a rose for a 7-, 12- or 24-step cycle and a network graph for looping links.

**`tc-chart`, the CLI and MCP tools:** 36 chart types (`histogram`, `combo`, `venn`); `suggestCharts` proposes a histogram for one measure with no groups, and a combo chart for two measures on very different scales.

**Chart** (`tc-chart`): any chart from a JSON spec – `{ type, data, encoding, options, title, description }` – checked first, what's wrong shown instead of a chart, only declared properties set. ztd-charts' specs draw as they are, and specs also draw Gauge, Heatmap, Radar Chart and Sparkline, their rows reshaped into those elements' properties.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
